title: Brans–Dicke Gravity (classic scalar–tensor)
efc_relevance: Scalar φ setting effective gravitational coupling G_eff = 1/φ, constrained by Solar-System tests to ω_BD > 40 000 (Cassini). EFC recovers Newtonian limit via K(ρ)-stiffness, not via large ω_BD. Kept as historical anchor and as member of scalar–tensor family sub-summed under Horndeski.
ledger_action: Logged as Horndeski ancestor. Solar-System bound is a EFC sanity check.
